built_by: Claude, from the PDF text. Investment only. The DSCR tier itself (1.00 and up vs .75 to .99) is picked in the matrix lookup; these rules are the overlays on top.

rules.label: Primary or second home
rules.quote: Occupancy | Investment Property

rules.label: Rural
rules.quote: Maximum LTV: Purchase/Rate and Term 80%; Cash Out 75%. Minimum DSCR 1.00.

rules.label: Rural with DSCR under 1.00
rules.quote: Maximum LTV: Purchase/Rate and Term 80%; Cash Out 75%. Minimum DSCR 1.00.

rules.label: 2 - 4 Units
rules.quote: 2- 4 Units, Warrantable and Non-Warrantable Condos- Purchase/Rate & Term Maximum LTV 80%; Cash Out Maximum LTV 75%.

rules.label: Warrantable Condo
rules.quote: 2- 4 Units, Warrantable and Non-Warrantable Condos- Purchase/Rate & Term Maximum LTV 80%; Cash Out Maximum LTV 75%.

rules.label: Non-Warrantable Condo
rules.quote: 2- 4 Units, Warrantable and Non-Warrantable Condos- Purchase/Rate & Term Maximum LTV 80%; Cash Out Maximum LTV 75%.

rules.label: Condotel
rules.quote: Condotels- Purchase/Rate & Term Maximum 75%; Cash Out Maximum 70%

rules.label: Cash out with DSCR .75 to .99
rules.quote: Unlimited Cash Out no LTV restrictions with DSCR 1.00 and above. Maximum LTV DSCR .75 to .99 = 70%

rules.label: Vacant property on a refinance
rules.quote: Vacant Property on Refinances: Reduce LTV by 5% from maximum qualifying.

rules.label: Interest Only
rules.quote: Interest Only: Calculate DSCR using ITIA payment. Max LTV 80%

rules.label: Reduced reserves
rules.quote: Reserve Requirement reduced by 3 months with 5% reduction from max qualifying LTV

rules.label: Non-permanent resident alien
rules.quote: Non-Permanent Resident Alien (with US Credit) with a maximum LTV of 75%.

rules.label: Declining Markets
rules.quote: If the appraisal reflects that the subject property is located in a declining market, reduce the LTV by 5%.

rules.label: First time investor under 660 FICO
rules.quote: First Time Investor | Minimum 660 credit score.

rules.label: First time investor over $1.5MM
rules.quote: No Gift Funds allowed. Maximum loan amount is $1,500,000.

rules.label: First time home buyer
rules.quote: No First Time Homebuyers allowed.

rules.label: Baltimore / Philadelphia
rules.quote: Geographic Overlays | Baltimore, MD and Philadelphia, PA are ineligible.

rules.label: Credit event 24 to 35 months ago
rules.quote: 36 months OR 24 months with a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV.

rules.label: Credit event under 24 months ago
rules.quote: 36 months OR 24 months with a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV.

rules.label: More than one 30-day mortgage late (no 60s)
rules.quote: Unlimited 30 days 0X60X12 allowed with a 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV.

rules.label: 60-day mortgage late in 12 months
rules.quote: 1x30x12; OR Unlimited 30 days 0X60X12 allowed
rules.confirm: Read as: any 60-day late in 12 months doesn't meet 1x30x12 or 0x60x12. Confirm with underwriting.

rules.label: Cash out, owned under 6 months
rules.quote: Less than 6 months ownership 5% reduction from maximum qualifying LTV

rules.label: Short-term rental
rules.quote: If the subject is a Short-Term Rental the LTV must be reduced by 5% from maximum qualifying.
